description: A statically OBJECT/ARRAY/MAP-typed value is not a number, refused in live's three distinct shapes: SUM/AVG and the numeric scalars name themselves in an argument-type list (bare AVG reporting the SUM it desugars into), MEDIAN and the percentile WITHIN GROUP value use the incompatible-types pair with a constant NUMBER(9,0), and the moment aggregates report their internal '*' listing the offending type twice - over empty inputs, every argument position, DISTINCT/windowed forms, conditionals, derived columns and producer functions, with structured types naming their whole parameterised type. The bounds: a VARIANT is never rejected at compile time (casting to VARIANT lifts the rejection, casting back brings it back, path reads yield accepted VARIANTs), the accepted aggregates / key positions / ordinary arithmetic / explicit conversions / semi-structured-aware functions all stay untouched. Converted 1:1 from expressions/SemiStructuredNumericArgumentTest (now retired).
